parts.text:
You are a hydrogeologist preparing site notes for a borehole drilling team.

Station Ulakwo (Etche LGA survey stations). Interpreted VES layer model:

Layer | Resistivity (ohm-m) | Thickness (m) | Depth to base (m)
----- | ------------------- | ------------- | -----------------
1 | 14.369 | 0.124 | 0.12415
2 | 15.965 | 8.25 | 9.665
3 | 4591.4 | 27.074 | 47.738
4 | 5101.5 | - | -

Write the site note using exactly this template:

Station: <station name>
Curve type: <VES curve type>
Aquifer depth: <depth range in m>
Recommendation: <one or two sentences for the drilling team>

Station: Ulakwo
Curve type: A-type (ρ1 < ρ2 < ρ3 < ρ4 — progressively increasing resistivity with depth)
Aquifer depth: 9.665 m – 47.738 m (resistive sandy layer, ρ = 4591.4 Ω·m), with a deeper, more resistive unit (5101.5 Ω·m) persisting below 47.738 m
Recommendation: Case off the shallow, low-resistivity overburden (0–9.665 m) to prevent contamination, and screen the borehole within the high-resistivity sand horizon from about 9.7 m to at least 47.7 m depth; consider drilling deeper to confirm whether the underlying 5101.5 Ω·m layer represents an additional productive aquifer or competent basement.
